svg.title: RPGV-Net architecture
svg.desc: Shared MiT-B2 RGB backbone with global FiLM, reliability-guided pseudo-depth rectification, geometry encoder and FPN, Haar boundary validation at stride four, region validation at stride sixteen, reliability-weighted residual fusion, multi-scale decoder and two-stage refinement.
svg.text: Qd = 0 suppresses geometry residuals; RGB features remain the fallback path.
